rebuilds.why: House notation: every option a temperature with the degree sign and a true minus sign ("-3" → "−3°C"). Same values, same tags; executions written for the three distractors, which had none. Round 2 (rev-agent-01): the one-step-off option −2°C (maths-107) is replaced by 13°C, the sum instead of the difference (maths-72), so no option is linked to two others and the key is not the smaller of a one-apart pair. The maths-71 execution now names the mechanism exactly.

stem.text: The temperature is 5°C. It falls by 8°C. What is the new temperature?

options.execution: The child loses the minus sign, or turns back at zero: 5 − 8 is −3, not 3. That gives 3°C instead of −3°C.
The child adds instead of taking away: 5 + 8 makes 13. A fall means taking away, so 5 − 8 is −3, which gives −3°C.
The child gives the size of the fall, 8, as the new temperature and never starts from 5°C. Starting at 5°C, a fall of 8 gives −3°C.
